findings.repository: tec-template-base + 19 apps (all but Life of those that declare it)
findings.title: The 60 % coverage floor is declared in 21 app repositories and enforced in one
findings.description: Each vitest.config declares thresholds (60/60/60/50); CI runs npm test without coverage and @vitest/coverage-v8 is not installed, so the floor never runs. Only Tec-Life runs test:coverage. The Hub, Assets, Commerce and Ecommerce declare no floor at all. Measured here, the template is at 69.5/61.2/63.9/74.9.

evidence.observation: floor declared; CI runs npm test

findings.root_cause: The floor was added to the config; the CI step and dependency were not.
findings.technical_impact: Coverage can fall to zero without CI noticing.
findings.business_impact: A gate everyone believes in that never runs.
findings.recommendation: Template: add @vitest/coverage-v8 and run test:coverage in CI; carry it by template-sync; measure each app first and set its floor no higher than it passes.
acceptance_criteria: CI fails when coverage falls below the floor in every app

findings.title: No test crosses a service boundary — event contracts are checked by neither side
findings.description: Each event's producer and consumers test against their own hand-written payloads; nothing checks that the stream name and shape one side writes is what the other reads. This cycle's costliest defects lived exactly there: commerce's order consumer was never registered and listened on the wrong stream (its own comment), the reconciliation wrote no event (0030), three consumers read a best-effort stream (0036). The two tests that use a real database skip in CI although the job already runs a Postgres.

evidence.observation: skip without TEST_DATABASE_URL; CI has Postgres

findings.root_cause: Tests are per service; the stream is nobody's test.
findings.technical_impact: A renamed stream or field passes every suite and fails silently in production.
findings.business_impact: Purchases not delivered, with green CI.
findings.recommendation: A contract fixture per event under shared/: the producer test asserts its real payload equals the fixture; each consumer test feeds the fixture through its handler. Set TEST_DATABASE_URL to the CI Postgres for the two real-database tests.
acceptance_criteria: Changing a field in the outbox payload fails a consumer test
The two real-database tests run in CI
